title: Ethyl Acetate Extract from Wenxia Formula (WFEA) Attenuates Immunosuppression in Lung Cancer by Inhibiting Treg Differentiation via Blockade of TGF-Beta/Smad Signaling.
authors: Wang, Meng; Han, Xiangyu; Li, Hui; Zheng, Bin; Fang, Dongdong; Jiang, Shulong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药提取物WFEA通过TGF-β/Smad信号通路抑制Treg分化改善肺癌免疫抑制，分子对接仅涉及小分子与TGF-β1蛋白结合，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: The ethyl acetate extract of Wenxia Formula (WFEA) is the most effective antitumor component of the Wenxia formula. Its key active components, emodin and quercetin, exhibit unique advantages in targeting TGF-beta1 and regulating the function of Tregs. This study explored the mechanism of WFEA in enhancing the immune environment in lung cancer by influencing immune cell balance and the level of cytokines. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Lewis lung cancer xenograft mouse models were established. WFEA was administered at low (100 mg/kg), medium (200 mg/kg), and high (400 mg/kg) doses, while a cisplatin (DDP) group served as the positive control. Tumor weight, spleen index, and serum cytokine levels (IL-10, TGF-beta1) were measured. Flow cytometry, qPCR, and immunohistochemistry were employed to analyze the proportion of CD4(+)CD25(+)Foxp3(+) Treg cells and Foxp3 expression in tumor and spleen tissues. The regulatory mechanism of WFEA on the TGF-beta/Smads signaling pathway was investigated via combined intervention with the TGF-beta1 inhibitor halofuginone (HF), cell differentiation assays, and molecular docking analyses. RESULTS: WFEA inhibited tumor growth in a dose-dependent manner, with the 400 mg/kg group exhibiting a 60% tumor inhibition rate comparable to that of DDP. The agent significantly increased the spleen index by 106.42% and reduced serum levels of IL-10 and TGF-beta1. Mechanistically, WFEA downregulated Foxp3 mRNA and protein expression in both tumor and spleen tissues, leading to a decrease in the proportion of Treg cells. It blocked the TGF-beta/Smads pathway by downregulating TGF-beta1, upregulating Smad4/Smad7, and inhibiting Smad2/3 phosphorylation. Cell-based experiments confirmed that WFEA-containing serum inhibited the differentiation of CD4(+) T cells into Tregs, an effect enhanced by TGF-beta1 interference. Molecular docking analyses revealed that the active components emodin and quercetin directly bound to TGF-beta1 with binding energies of -5.4 kcal/mol and -5.1 kcal/mol, respectively. DISCUSSION: WFEA could serve as a new adjunct treatment for lung cancer; however, further clinical trials are required to evaluate its long-term safety and effectiveness across various treatment stages. CONCLUSION: WFEA may regulate the growth of Tregs to modulate the immune microenvironment of the LLC model mice, indicating its potential as an anti-LLC agent.
abstract_zh: 引言：温下方乙酸乙酯提取物（WFEA）是温下方最具抗肿瘤活性的组分。其关键活性成分大黄素（emodin）和槲皮素（quercetin）在靶向TGF-beta1和调节Tregs功能方面展现出独特优势。本研究探讨了WFEA通过影响免疫细胞平衡和细胞因子水平增强肺癌免疫环境的机制。材料与方法：建立Lewis肺癌异种移植小鼠模型。给予WFEA低（100 mg/kg）、中（200 mg/kg）、高（400 mg/kg）剂量，同时设顺铂（DDP）组作为阳性对照。测量肿瘤重量、脾脏指数和血清细胞因子水平（IL-10、TGF-beta1）。采用流式细胞术、qPCR和免疫组织化学分析肿瘤和脾脏组织中CD4(+)CD25(+)Foxp3(+) Treg细胞比例及Foxp3表达。通过TGF-beta1抑制剂卤夫酮（halofuginone, HF）联合干预、细胞分化实验和分子对接分析，研究WFEA对TGF-beta/Smads信号通路的调控机制。结果：WFEA以剂量依赖性方式抑制肿瘤生长，其中400 mg/kg组肿瘤抑制率达60%，与DDP相当。该药物显著增加脾脏指数106.42%，并降低血清IL-10和TGF-beta1水平。机制上，WFEA下调肿瘤和脾脏组织中Foxp3 mRNA和蛋白表达，导致Treg细胞比例下降。它通过下调TGF-beta1、上调Smad4/Smad7并抑制Smad2/3磷酸化来阻断TGF-beta/Smads通路。细胞实验证实，含WFEA血清抑制CD4(+) T细胞向Tregs分化，且TGF-beta1干扰增强此效应。分子对接分析显示，活性成分大黄素和槲皮素直接结合TGF-beta1，结合能分别为-5.4 kcal/mol和-5.1 kcal/mol。讨论：WFEA可作为肺癌的新型辅助治疗手段；然而，需进一步临床试验评估其在不同治疗阶段的长期安全性和有效性。结论：WFEA可能通过调节Tregs生长来调控LLC模型小鼠的免疫微环境，表明其作为抗LLC药物的潜力。
